findings.passage: "This is not about the process. This is about suppressing the vote of the same group of people, especially me and people who look like me, and I take it personally. I am here in this chamber because of the Voting Rights Act," state Sen. Gail Davenport said. "Some good-hearted legislators want to please a former selfish, racist leader and his followers. Well, I tell you today, don't do it."
findings.note: Spoken in Senate debate on SB 241, a 2021 bill that would have ended no-excuse absentee voting and required a driver's license or state ID number for absentee applications and returns. Quoted by ABC News (Good Morning America). The quote does not name the ID provision.
